key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19B0
name: write_byte_to_three_pointers
description: Stores one byte from a data register into the three memory locations addressed by three address registers, then returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19BC
name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two other routines one after the other and returns; the decompiler could not resolve either call target.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19C4
name: clear_nibbles_and_mark_runs
description: Clears the low nibble of each byte in one table up to a terminator, then walks a second table and sets flag bits 1, 2 and 4 on the entries that bound each run.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19D8
name: mark_run_flags_from_table
description: Walks a table of indices, reads a word per index and sets flag bits in a parallel table on the entries at the start and end of each run, until a terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19F2
name: mark_run_flags_by_index
description: Reads an index table and a second table in step, setting flag bits on entries that begin and end each run, and stops at a terminator value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A24
name: mark_flags_forward_scan
description: Scans forward through the two tables, setting flag bits when a boundary condition is met, and jumps back into the scan loop to continue marking.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A48
name: mark_flags_backward_scan
description: Scans through the two tables with a jump back into the loop, setting boundary flag bits as it goes and returning when the terminator is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A72
name: scan_and_set_flag_bits
description: Loops over a table of indices and a parallel flag table, setting the flag bits on the current and following entries when a bit test is met.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A78
name: set_flag_bits_then_scan
description: Sets three flag bits on the current and preceding table entries, then scans forward setting boundary flags until a terminator is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A8E
name: compute_scaled_buffer_writes
description: Divides a fixed constant by a stored word to get a per-step value, then walks two tables writing scaled byte results into a buffer at computed offsets.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1AF0
name: fill_buffer_with_scaled_values
description: Walks two tables, dividing a stored constant by table values and writing the quotients into a buffer at computed offsets until a terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1B00
name: fill_interpolated_buffer_values
description: Accumulates offsets from one table, writes scaled quotients into a buffer and computes a difference between two table values to place intermediate samples.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1B34
name: compute_weighted_interpolation_steps
description: Takes absolute differences of two stored values, divides a scaled count by their sum and writes the resulting interpolation step into a buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1B48
name: write_weighted_interpolation_tail
description: Repeats the weighted interpolation step over a table, writing each computed value into the buffer and finishing with a final division write.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1BB4
name: write_scaled_samples_with_step
description: Loads three table values per entry, writes a division result into the buffer and then walks a flag table to find the next run before writing again.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1BCA
name: write_divided_levels_stride_eight
description: Divides a stored value by a fixed constant and writes the result into every eighth byte of a buffer until a terminator value is found.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1BE4
name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it leaves all state unchanged.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1BE8
name: process_channel_table_entries
description: Iterates over channel table entries, calls two subroutines to fetch values and writes computed results into a buffer, using a terminator to end.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1C22
name: process_channel_entries_forward
description: Steps through channel table entries, calling a subroutine for each marked entry and writing results into a buffer until the terminator is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1C3A
name: advance_and_process_channel_entries
description: Advances two table pointers together, calls a subroutine on flagged entries and writes the output values, returning at the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1C42
name: process_table_entries_with_helpers
description: Walks a table of entries and calls up to three subroutines for each one, using the neighbouring table bytes to choose which subroutine runs next.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1CBA
name: select_neighbour_flags_and_process
description: Reads flag bits from the current table entry and, depending on them, either calls a subroutine or jumps to the next neighbour-processing step.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1CD2
name: read_previous_neighbour_bytes
description: Reads the bytes before and after the current table position, substituting an earlier byte when one is zero, and calls subroutines depending on flag bits.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1CE2
name: accumulate_neighbour_table_values
description: Looks up table values for the neighbouring positions of each entry and combines them, using substitute bytes where a neighbour is zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1CFC
name: compare_neighbour_table_flags
description: Compares the flags of the two neighbours of each entry and calls a subroutine when the flag pattern matches a boundary case.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1D0C
name: process_flagged_neighbour_entries
description: Processes table entries whose flag bits indicate a neighbour boundary, calling a subroutine and recording the result in a flag buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1D8A
name: scale_table_values_by_flags
description: Reads a table value for each entry, shifts it right when a flag is clear, and writes the result back in a buffer used by the next step.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1DA4
name: blend_table_values_toward_target
description: Computes a weighted difference between a stored value and a target value, shifts the result and adds it back to the current sample.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1DAC
name: write_blended_sample_values
description: Applies the same weighted blend to each table entry and stores the blended bytes into the output buffer until the terminator is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1E12
name: compute_scaled_shifted_product
description: Multiplies a 16-bit input by a 16-bit value, then returns the high word of the product together with the low word after adding a constant and shifting right by five.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1E1C
name: initialize_and_clear_buffers
description: Stores offsets relative to a base pointer into a state structure, advances some pointers, clears several word fields and zeroes six blocks of memory.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1EE0
name: advance_counter_and_run_steps
description: Increments a 16-bit counter in the state structure and, while it has not wrapped and the increment did not overflow, calls four subroutine steps.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1F02
name: pack_nibble_values_into_buffer
description: Walks a table of entries, extracts a scaled nibble for each marked entry, counts marked positions and packs the results into a buffer, returning once a fixed count is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1F58
name: pack_entries_into_buffer_forward
description: Scans table entries forward, packs a nibble value for each into a buffer and records the first and last positions where a flag is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1F76
name: pack_entries_and_mark_end
description: Packs flagged table values into a buffer and sets an end-of-run flag bit on the last written byte before returning.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1FC0
name: set_flag_and_store_indices
description: Sets an end-of-run bit on the byte at the current index and stores two index values into the state structure, copying one conditionally.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1FD8
name: fill_flag_buffer_from_tables
description: Reads paired table entries, sets flag bits in the output buffer for each entry that matches a pattern and stops when the terminator is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2010
name: set_flag_bits_in_buffer
description: Walks the buffer and writes a fixed flag value into positions that the table marks, moving forward through the buffer until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2032
name: set_flag_bits_backward
description: Walks the buffer backward from the current position, setting flag bits and copying a marker value when the table indicates a run start.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2054
name: propagate_flags_backward_through_buffer
description: Walks the buffer backward, propagating a flag value to earlier positions until a boundary entry is found, and clears the source byte when moved.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:206C
name: propagate_marker_flags_backward
description: Walks a buffer backward ORing a flag into each byte and moves marker bits between neighbouring positions when a table value indicates a transition.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:208E
name: scan_for_flag_markers
description: Scans leftward through a table for the next flagged position, moving marker bits and clearing the source byte when a target is found.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:20A8
name: swap_and_clear_byte_flags
description: Moves a table byte from one position to another, clears the source when the positions differ, decrements the index and propagates a flag bit forward or backward.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:20BC
name: set_low_bit_across_range
description: Sets bit zero on each byte in a range of positions, counting down from the highest index to zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:20C4
name: set_low_bit_counting_down
description: Sets bit zero on each byte from the current index down to zero, stopping after the first position.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:20D0
name: or_mask_with_early_exit
description: Chooses a mask from a control byte and ORs it into a run of bytes in one buffer, returning early once a flag in another buffer is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:210A
name: write_mask_clear_nibble_leftward
description: ORs a mask into the current byte and, when a flag is set, scans leftward to the nearest flagged entry and clears its low nibble before setting bit two.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2160
name: accumulate_table_entries
description: Adds a word value to eight consecutive table entries, first calling up to seven subroutine steps chosen by two stored flags.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:21B8
name: compute_scaled_table_byte
description: Derives a byte from a computed scale value, clamps it into a fixed range and stores it into a table entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:21F2
name: clamp_value_and_store_char
description: Clamps a 16-bit value to a fixed lower and upper bound and stores the resulting byte at an indexed table position.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:220C
name: distribute_quotient_across_range
description: Divides a character difference by a count and distributes the quotient and its remainder across a range of flagged positions.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:22B6
name: adjust_table_values_loop
description: Repeatedly computes an absolute difference between two table entries, scales it into a destination byte and scans backward for flagged entries, then applies a scaled correction to the flagged range.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:230C
name: scale_flagged_entries_into_tables
description: Multiplies table values for each flagged entry by fixed scale factors, writes the products into two output tables and applies a rounding adjustment.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2394
name: scale_entries_and_store_results
description: Computes scaled values for each entry in a range using multiplication and shifts, storing them into two tables and adjusting a running accumulator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:23B2
name: scale_flagged_entries_and_finish
description: Repeats the scaled-value computation over flagged entries and, at the end of the range, copies a table byte and applies a fixed offset to it.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:23CE
name: adjust_pairs_of_flagged_entries
description: Walks flagged entries backward in pairs, applying scaled corrections to both positions in each pair, and handles a two-step gap separately.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:23E0
name: adjust_flagged_entry_pairs_inplace
description: Applies scaled corrections in place to adjacent flagged entry pairs, using a comparison of the two neighbours to choose which value to update.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:240C
name: update_pair_with_difference
description: Adjusts a pair of table entries by a rounded difference of their neighbours and a scaled term, storing the result back in place.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:242A
name: update_entries_in_reverse_order
description: Updates table entries from the highest index downward, combining each with a scaled difference and writing the results back into the output tables.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:244A
name: update_entries_with_difference_pass
description: Performs one pass over the table entries applying the scaled difference correction and storing the adjusted values for the next stage.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:246A
name: scale_pair_differences_into_tables
description: Computes differences between paired table entries, scales them and writes the results into two output tables over a range of flagged positions.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:248E
name: find_running_max_and_scale
description: Tracks a running maximum over a range of table bytes and writes a scaled value derived from it into the output buffer, with a constant correction.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2496
name: apply_scaled_offsets_to_pairs
description: Applies scaled offsets to pairs of table entries selected by a mode value, updating the destination bytes and a running accumulator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:24BE
name: apply_scaled_offsets_with_mode
description: Applies mode-dependent scale factors to a pair of table entries and then clears the source bytes when a flag in the mask is not set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:24DA
name: apply_mode_offsets_to_pair
description: Adds a mode-selected offset to the first entry of a pair and a second mode-selected offset to the second, with a fixed correction when a flag is clear.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2506
name: apply_mode_offsets_and_scan
description: Applies mode-selected offsets to a pair of entries, then scans through flagged positions updating the running maximum.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2532
name: scan_running_max_with_offsets
description: Scans flagged positions in a range, applying scaled offsets to each entry and updating the running maximum until the start of the range.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:25AC
name: compute_running_max_scaled_byte
description: Finds the largest value in a range of table bytes, scales it and stores the result into the output buffer as a correction for the current position.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:25C0
name: compute_scaled_running_max_backward
description: Repeats the running-maximum computation backward through the table and stores each scaled correction, stopping when a non-flagged entry is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:25D4
name: adjust_bytes_by_running_maximum
description: Updates a destination byte from a source byte by a scaled running-maximum correction, then propagates a fixed adjustment over flagged positions in the range.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:25F8
name: scale_nonzero_nibbles_backward
description: Walks a buffer backward and, for every byte with a nonzero high nibble, multiplies its value by a signed scale factor and adds the result to the accumulator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2608
name: scale_bytes_with_high_nibble
description: Scales bytes that have a nonzero high nibble by a signed factor selected from a flag bit, accumulating the products into the output buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2632
name: scale_bytes_by_signed_factor
description: Walks a byte range backward, skipping bytes whose high nibble is zero, and multiplies the destination byte by a sign-selected factor to update the accumulator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2642
name: shift_and_blend_table_bands
description: Computes shifted differences over bands of flagged table entries, scales them and blends the results into two tables, repeating over the band count.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:26E8
name: copy_and_offset_table_bytes
description: Copies table bytes forward across a range of flagged positions and adds a fixed offset to each copied value in the output table.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:270C
name: copy_runs_with_nibble_offset
description: Chooses one of two copy routines by a count, otherwise copies runs of bytes and adds a nibble-scaled offset to each copied byte in the output table.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:273A
name: copy_bytes_with_nibble_offset
description: Copies bytes across a range of flagged positions and adds a nibble-scaled offset to each copied byte, looping until the count is exhausted.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2762
name: blend_run_pairs_halfway
description: Blends paired run values by half their difference, writing the adjusted values back into two tables and continuing for each flagged run.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2770
name: blend_run_pairs_alternate
description: Blends paired run values by half their difference as in the neighbouring routine, with the adjustment applied to a different output table.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:277E
name: fill_runs_with_nibble_steps
description: Fills each run of positions with values in fixed steps of a nibble-scaled amount, spreading the result between the run's start and end.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:278A
name: fill_range_with_scaled_steps
description: Writes a nibble-scaled value into each byte of a range, then scans for the start of the next flagged run and fills it with a divided step value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:27C8
name: compute_run_max_steps
description: Computes the running maximum over a run of table bytes and writes scaled step values into the output buffer, with a copy of the boundary byte.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:27F2
name: shift_run_and_write_maximum
description: Shifts a run of table bytes by one position, then writes the maximum of the run as a scaled value into the output buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:282C
name: write_running_maximum_correction
description: Finds the largest table byte in a range and stores a scaled correction derived from it at the end of the range.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2834
name: write_scaled_running_maximum
description: Accumulates table bytes over a range, keeping a running maximum, and writes a scaled value and a derived value into several output buffers.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2864
name: scale_backward_from_flagged_entries
description: Walks flagged entries backward and applies a scaled correction to the output tables, using a constant factor for the first entry of each run.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:287E
name: scale_backward_flagged_pairs
description: Walks flagged entries backward in pairs, scaling each entry with a constant factor and applying the result to two output tables.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:28B8
name: scale_and_accumulate_flagged_run
description: Scales the entry at the current position and accumulates the result into the output table, then walks the preceding flagged positions in the same run.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:28D2
name: scale_run_with_offset_table
description: Scales the value at each position of a run using a factor from an offset table and writes the result into the output table, moving back through the run.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2906
name: scale_and_store_backward_run
description: Applies a scaled correction to each position of a backward run, storing the adjusted values into the output tables until the run start is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:295C
name: scale_entries_with_fixed_factor
description: Multiplies table entries by a fixed factor selected by a count and applies the rounded product to the output table over a range.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:296A
name: scale_entries_with_alternate_factor
description: Multiplies table entries by a second fixed factor and applies the rounded product to the output table, walking the range backward.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2970
name: scale_entries_with_small_factor
description: Multiplies table entries by a small fixed factor and applies the rounded product to the output table, walking the range backward until the start.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:298E
name: adjust_buffers_by_signed_delta
description: Walks the range backward, applying a signed delta derived from a table value to several output buffers wherever the flag bits match.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:29A2
name: copy_bytes_with_feedback_step
description: Copies bytes between two buffers while updating a feedback value from a table entry, writing the adjusted bytes to a third buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:29A4
name: adjust_bytes_with_feedback
description: Copies bytes between buffers, updates a feedback value by multiplying it with a table entry and shifting, then subtracts the feedback from each byte before writing it out.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:29D4
name: check_narrator_flag_and_dispatch
description: Calls a fixed series of routines, then checks one flag byte in the state structure and calls one more routine when it is nonzero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2A4A
name: call_three_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls three other routines one after the other and returns; the decompiler could not resolve the call targets.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2A6A
name: interpolate_bytes_at_stride_eight
description: Interpolates linearly between two source bytes and writes the results into every eighth byte of the output buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2A92
name: scan_stride_records_and_dispatch
description: Steps through eight-byte records until a terminator, advancing the pointer for the first record and calling a subroutine for each later record that is not a marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2AA4
name: dispatch_stride_records_until_end
description: Steps through eight-byte records until a terminator, advancing the record pointer on each full stride and calling a subroutine for the others.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2AB6
name: skip_stride_records_and_call
description: Walks eight-byte records, calls a subroutine when a record is not the first in its group, and returns when the terminator value is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2ABA
name: scan_stride_eight_until_marker
description: Scans eight-byte records for the next non-zero entry, advancing the pointer after each full stride, and returns on the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2AD0
name: advance_stride_records_and_call
description: Advances through eight-byte records, calling a subroutine for each boundary record until the terminator is found.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2ADC
name: skip_stride_records_to_marker
description: Searches eight-byte records for the next nonzero byte, calling a subroutine whenever the search leaves the current group, and stops at the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2AE0
name: render_table_entries_to_buffer
description: Walks paired table entries and, for each flagged entry, copies a fixed pattern of rows into the output buffer; otherwise it advances the output by the entry count.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B10
name: copy_glyph_rows_for_entries
description: Copies five-row pattern data for each flagged entry into the output buffer, choosing the pattern from the symbol byte and stepping through the entry count.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B6A
name: copy_glyph_rows_stepping_entries
description: Copies a five-row pattern for each flagged entry into the output buffer, selecting one of three patterns by symbol value and advancing by the entry count.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B70
name: copy_rows_for_run_lengths
description: Copies pattern rows for each run, adds a shading value to the first row of each half-run and applies a nibble reduction to the rest of the run.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B82
name: copy_rows_run_lengths_alt
description: Repeats the run-length row copy with the shading applied to a different row of each run, then finishes the remaining run.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2B92
name: copy_rows_for_second_symbol
description: Copies a fixed pattern of rows for entries whose symbol byte is the second symbol value and advances the output by the entry count.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2BA2
name: copy_glyph_rows_default_symbol
description: Copies the default pattern rows for each entry, shading the first row of each run and reducing the nibble of the remaining rows.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2BC6
name: copy_previous_entry_rows
description: Copies the three bytes from the previous eight-byte row into the current row for marked entries, and handles run boundaries with a nibble update.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2BF2
name: copy_previous_rows_with_mask
description: Copies the previous row values forward for marked entries and updates the nibble fields of the boundary rows using a mask from the control table.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2C02
name: copy_previous_rows_nibble_mask
description: Like the neighbouring routine, copies previous row values and updates nibble fields under a mask, with an extra clear step when a flag is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2C32
name: adjust_nibble_fields_for_entries
description: Adjusts the high and low nibble fields of boundary rows for each entry, copying rows forward where the control byte requires it and clearing the fields on a sentinel.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2CEC
name: adjust_nibble_fields_until_marker
description: Adjusts nibble fields in the output rows for each entry and stops once the terminator value is found.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D1C
name: remap_rows_through_lookup_table
description: Walks output rows until a terminator, skipping the marker value and replacing the three row bytes in each row with values from a lookup table.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D3E
name: copy_rows_from_lookup
description: Copies three lookup-table bytes into each eight-byte row, stepping through the rows until a marker value is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D52
name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it leaves all state unchanged.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D54
name: average_column_bytes_into_row
description: Sums seven bytes down a run of records, stopping at a terminator, and adds the total into the eighth byte of the record as an averaged value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D70
name: smooth_running_sum_into_rows
description: Keeps a running sum of record bytes and writes an averaged value into each record's last byte until the terminator, with a correction from the previous row.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2D86
name: combine_weighted_row_sums
description: Computes weighted sums of record bytes and stores the combined result in the record's last byte, returning when a terminator is found.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2DA4
name: combine_weighted_running_sums
description: Accumulates weighted byte pairs across records and writes the combined value into the final byte of each record, looping until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2DCA
name: add_class_offset_to_rows
description: Adds a class-dependent offset to the rows of each entry, using a fixed value for the second symbol class and a scaled term for the rest.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2DEC
name: add_class_offset_per_symbol
description: Adds a symbol-dependent offset to the rows of each entry and handles one special symbol class by writing a fixed value into each row.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E38
name: add_offset_rows_by_symbol
description: Adds a fixed offset to every row of each entry, choosing the offset from the symbol class and skipping rows for the flagged symbol.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E48
name: add_negative_offset_to_rows
description: Adds a negative offset to each row of an entry, with the offset value chosen from the symbol class, and advances the row pointer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E4C
name: add_negative_offset_rows_variant
description: Adds a negative offset to rows of each entry with the same class logic as the neighbouring routine, returning on the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E50
name: add_negative_offset_rows_alt
description: Repeats the negative-offset row update for entries of a different class and returns when the terminator is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E54
name: subtract_offset_then_add_class
description: Subtracts a class offset from entries that carry the flagged bit, then adds a second class-dependent value to the rows that follow.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E68
name: apply_slope_then_offset_rows
description: Applies a scaled slope term to each entry's rows and then adds a class offset to the rows of the next entry, until the terminator.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2E80
name: compute_nibble_checksums_in_groups
description: Sums the low and then the high nibbles of byte groups in two passes and writes the masked result into the third byte of each group, the same checksum shape used by other routines.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5230
name: allocate_signal_and_wait_loop
description: Allocates an exec signal, reads the current task and waits on the signal mask in a loop, calling a subroutine each time a wake-up arrives.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:526E
name: poll_io_request_until_done
description: Repeatedly checks an I/O request's flag bits and calls the library routine that starts it, clearing the request flags when it finishes.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:52A4
name: clear_io_request_flags
description: Clears two flag bits in an I/O request structure, leaving the other flags unchanged.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:52B4
name: setup_speech_request_io
description: Fills in a speech I/O request with its buffer, length and attribute fields, then runs the exec DoIO call to send it.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5370
name: copy_blocks_enable_audio_dma
description: Copies blocks of data into audio buffer records and writes the DMA control register to enable the audio channels, restoring the previous state afterwards.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:548A
name: mix_channel_samples_to_output
description: Adds sample bytes from two channel tables for each output position, writes each sum into the output buffer twice and decrements a per-channel counter.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5514
name: advance_audio_channel_state
description: Updates a channel's phase accumulators and periods, writes sample bytes to the output and toggles DMA control when a per-channel counter reaches zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:558C
name: mix_channel_samples_into_buffer
description: Mixes sample bytes from channel tables into an output buffer, updating each channel's position and looping through a lookup table for the next sample.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:5610
name: mix_channel_samples_with_lookup
description: Adds two lookup-table sample values for each output position and writes the sum to two adjacent output bytes, switching channel buffers when a counter wraps.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:56AE
name: advance_audio_sample_stream
description: Advances through sample stream records, writes combined sample bytes to the output and calls subroutines when the per-channel counter expires.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:56DC
name: parse_sample_stream_records
description: Reads sample stream records, sets record fields from the record bytes and clears the channel fields when a new record starts.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:56EA
name: wait_io_and_reenable_dma
description: Waits for each pending I/O request in turn and enables the audio DMA channels in the control register if the channel flag is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:573E
name: enable_dma_if_flag_set
description: Tests a flag byte in the channel structure and, if it is set, writes the DMA control register with the enable bit set.
